We implement, sell, integrate and install Odoo — the all-in-one ERP that runs accounting, CRM, sales, inventory, manufacturing, HR and more from a single platform. Our unique offering is that we go beyond standard implementation: we connect Odoo to our own AI and automation solutions — voice AI, WhatsApp and SMS messaging, automated lead qualification and workflow automation — so your ERP doesn't just record your business, it actively runs and grows it. What is Odoo? Odoo is a modular, open-source ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) suite that brings a company's core operations into one integrated system. Instead of separate tools for accounting, sales, inventory and HR, Odoo provides connected apps that share a single database. Businesses adopt Odoo because it is flexible, cost-effective and scales from a small company on a few apps to a large enterprise running the full suite. As a Certified Odoo Partner, NetOn Technologies handles licensing, implementation, customisation, integration and ongoing support.
